attempts.why: THE ONE LVX144 CHANGES. 'Shall we reschedule your appointment to Thursday, September 24 at 2:00 PM?' answered with 'the Thursday 2 p.m.' -- the caller naming the exact slot back, which is how people confirm times out loud. readback_now=true and agreed_now=FALSE, so the write was refused, changed_rows was 0, and the model told the caller it had been done anyway. The slot named is the slot being written, on the right weekday, with no withdrawal and no question mark, so this now reads as agreement and writes.
